verdict.rationale: Morph documents high-throughput generation for its specialized models: Fast Apply via morph-v3-fast at 10,500+ tok/s, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, and Reflex classifiers labeling a turn in about 90ms. It also lists latency-relevant serving features, including automatic prefix caching and dedicated reserved-capacity endpoints. Time-to-first-token is never quantified, and throughput numbers for the general chat models (e.g. Kimi K3) are absent, so only part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented TTFT or latency figures, throughput benchmarks for the general open-weight chat models, independent or hands-on speed corroboration.
